title: Her, him, and the bridge, in one

turns.text: These two (first two photos) cycling side by side across the Golden Gate Bridge from the third photo, both in helmets, fog behind. Keep both faces and both pairs of glasses. 16:9.

tests: Two faces with glasses plus a place: fine detail (glasses) under an action pose.

answer_sheet.Who: The woman in the first photo and the man in the second, glasses kept.

must_haves: Both people are present and match the attached photos: a woman with long dark hair and round glasses, a man with glasses and a short beard.
Both wear glasses and helmets and ride bicycles side by side.
The red towers and cables of the Golden Gate Bridge are behind them.
